mismatches.say: Dana sends Tony's application to the insurance company. An underwriter decides: accept the risk? How much insurance? At what rate?
mismatches.heard: Dana sends Tony's application to the insurance company, and Underwriter decides, accept the risk, how much insurance, at what rate.

mismatches.say: Underwriters also watch the loss ratio across their book of business: incurred losses divided by earned premium. Your turn.
mismatches.heard: Underwriters also watch the loss ratio across their book of business. Encurred losses divided by earned premium. Your turn.

mismatches.say: Physical: the property. Moral: dishonesty or a motive to profit from a loss. Morale: meh, careless because insurance will pay.
mismatches.heard: Physical the property. Moral, dishonesty, or a motive to profit from a loss. Morale, may careless because insurance will pay.

mismatches.say: Coinsurance, coming later, can cut a claim payment on underinsured property. With blanket, it applies to the total value under that limit.
mismatches.heard: Coinsurance, coming later, can cut a claim payment on under-insured property. With Blanket, it applies to the total value under that limit.

mismatches.say: Depending on the policy and state law, A C V can also be fair market value, or the broad evidence rule, which weighs all relevant evidence of value.

mismatches.say: The charred kitchen was a direct loss; the lost sales, consequential. Stated amount is a ceiling; agreed value suspends coinsurance.
